home.featuresHeading: What ships out of the box

f01.title: Lighthouse 100s on mobile
f01.body: Layered CSS with above-the-fold scoped styles, Tailwind below the fold, and Beasties critical-CSS extraction. CI-enforced.

f02.title: Typed Schema.org JSON-LD
f02.body: schema-dts builders compose into a single @graph. Catch malformed structured data at build, not in Search Console.

f03.title: Native i18n
f03.body: Astro 5 i18n routing with one code path for monolingual and multilingual sites. Hreflang auto-computed.

f04.title: Working contact form
f04.body: Astro Actions + Zod validation + honeypot + your choice of Resend or SMTP. Dev mode logs to console.

f05.title: Cookie banner + legal templates
f05.body: Privacy, terms, cookies — translated, with a "review with counsel" disclaimer baked in.

f06.title: You own the code
f06.body: No runtime dependency. Edit anything. Forever. Yours, line by line.

body.p1: Replace this content with your story. The page is a regular Astro component using BaseLayout directly — no separate layout is needed for static pages like this one.
body.p2: Pages that don't fit a content collection live as .astro files in src/pages/. They call t() for translated copy and pass the result to BaseLayout for SEO. Specialized layouts (Article, Project, Legal) handle the collection-driven pages.
body.heading: What goes here
body.li1: Who you are or what your team does
body.li3: How to get in touch (the contact form lives at /contact)

hero.lede: SEO, i18n, perf, legal, and email — pre-wired with sane defaults you actually own. No runtime dependency. No lock-in.

features.headline: Twenty things you'd otherwise build at 11pm.
features.meta: You own every line. No runtime dependency on this tool — eject is free, because there's nothing to eject.

f01.title: Lighthouse 100s
f01.body: Mobile and desktop. CI budgets fail the build before regressions ship.

f02.title: Astro 5 + i18n
f02.body: Native i18n, content collections, and Astro Actions. Strict Zod schemas.

f03.title: Tailwind v4
f03.body: Layered CSS strategy. Scoped above-the-fold + critical-CSS extraction.

f04.title: Typed JSON-LD
f04.body: Schema.org via schema-dts. Compile-time errors instead of stale snippets.

f05.title: Image pipeline
f05.body: AVIF + WebP, responsive srcset, LQIP placeholders, zero CLS.

f06.title: Self-hosted fonts
f06.body: Geist Sans + Mono via astro:fonts. Subsetted, preloaded, zero CLS.

f07.title: Tri-state dark mode
f07.body: Light / dark / system, with anti-flash inline script. No FOUC.

f08.title: Working contact form
f08.body: Astro Actions + Zod validation + Resend or SMTP. Wired, not a stub.

f09.title: Cookies + legal
f09.body: Banner, privacy, terms, and cookies templates. i18n-aware.
